body.data: SELECT T.TERMINAL_ID, T.MERCHANT_ID, T.TERMINAL_KIND, T.MAKE, T.POS_MODEL, T.POS_CONDITION, T.POS_MCC, T.SIM_SERIAL_WE, T.SIM_SERIAL_VOD, T.SIM_IP, T.PORT, T.SCHEME_MASTERCARD, T.SCHEME_VISA, T.SCHEME_MEEZA, T.CAP_PURCHASE, T.CAP_VOID, T.CAP_REFUND, T.CAP_OFFLINE_SALE, T.CAP_CASH_OUT, T.AUTO_SETTLEMENT, T.INSTALLMENT, T.CONVENIENCE_FEES, T.STATUS, T.VENDOR_SEND_DATE, T.VENDOR_STATUS, T.MERCHANT_DELIVERY_DATE, T.ACTIVATE_DATE, T.CREATED_AT, T.UPDATED_AT, T.CREATED_BY, T.UPDATED_BY FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL T WHERE T.MERCHANT_ID = HEXTORAW('{{ appsmith.URL.queryParams.MERCHANT_ID || "59F2A096E5047D26E063C642320AB95B" }}') AND T.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CASE T.TERMINAL_KIND WHEN 'POS' THEN 1 WHEN 'POC' THEN 2 WHEN 'UPG' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, T.TERMINAL_ID
